acceptance_criteria: Produce normalized course, section, meeting, instructor, GenEd, and prerequisite tables with documented grain and keys.
Section output contains term, subject, number, CRN, section, Part of Term, date range, and credit; meeting output contains day, start time, end time, and room.
Create conflict edges only for different sections in the same term whose date ranges, weekdays, and time intervals overlap; ARRANGED and TBA meetings create no false conflict.
Record acquisition status, HTTP status, file hash, source rows, normalized rows, and missing critical fields for every 2021-2023 target term.
Use official-structure offline fixtures for parser tests; acquisition tests require no live network; the full pytest suite passes.
README and data dictionary document commands, outputs, field meanings, WAF limitations, and why schedule overlap is not observed student registration conflict.
Show scheduling results in Streamlit only when verified data exist; otherwise retain an explicit insufficient-data explanation.
payload.objective: Implement the first-priority UIUC Course Explorer extension: courses, sections and CRNs, instructors, meeting dates/times/rooms, credit, GenEd attributes, Part of Term, prerequisites, and reproducible time-overlap conflict edges.
payload.scope: Use the 2021-2023 primary window. Before consuming the unique DeepSeek attempt, run the offline doctor and ensure the approved execution runtime permits outbound HTTPS to the configured DeepSeek endpoint; do not probe by calling DeepSeek. Then add lawful acquisition/cache adapters, official XML or page parsers, normalized tables, conflict computation, quality evidence, offline tests, and run documentation. Never bypass WAF or fabricate missing data. If live UIUC acquisition remains blocked, preserve failure evidence and validate cache/fixture processing. Exclude enrollment, capacity, and waitlist. Do not describe timetable overlap as observed student registration conflict.
